data: Which of the following terms had a POT score that decreased early in 2020?

The POT score for "coronavirus" decreased early in 2020. The POT scores for "lockdown" and "pandemic" increased early in 2020. The S&P 500 Index remained relatively stable with minor fluctuations. Therefore, the term with a decreasing POT score early in 2020 is "coronavirus".
